page.overview:
Who is Danté Terrapin?

Sir Danté Terrapin is a galapa warrior and a member of the Menagerie, a small group of adventurers. He is played by Taliesin Jaffe.

Danté is a galapa of turquoise skin with a scar in his face, dressed in elegant clothes, and carrying fancy weapons, and a hat with a beautiful feather.

Sir Danté is a posh individual that values reputation a lot. Some of his behavior seems rehearsed, particularly when he laughs.

In the past, a man humilliated Danté terribly. Eventually, the galapa teamed up with the Menagerie and became an adventurer. At one point, he and Bunnie dealt with a strange phenomenon (a red mist) that affected people, and she saved him when that weird fog was drowning him. He got to meet Dyson Broche once.
